messages:
alice: :rotating_light: Paging on-call — alert: KV prefix cache storm on model-redwood-v2 (us-east-1). Streaming endpoints high latency and increased 5xx.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-71 | Severity: P2 | Tags: kv-cache,batching,model-redwood-v2 | page: @ben

ben: I'm taking this. saw cache_size jump ~2GB -> ~118GB on serving-nodes-5..8.

sara: Customer impact: acme-inc experiencing timeouts on several long-lived sessions. CS notified; Raj engaged.

ops-mike: Telemetry: continuous-batcher queue depth rising alongside unique prefix key count. Looks like prefix cache rewarm storm after template normalization change.

alice: @ben is it just prefix cache keys or global KV? Any tokenizer mismatch evidence?

ben: prefix-only. logs:
```
2026-04-23T18:12:03Z ERROR cache_evict: prefix_collision detected for prefix_hash=0x9ab3f
2026-04-23T18:12:04Z INFO kv_cache.size bytes=118453324928
2026-04-23T18:12:06Z WARN batcher.enqueue latency_ms=3400 pending=74
```

sara: we rolled a prompt template edit this morning that changed unicode normalization (NFC vs NFD). possible cause.

ben: confirmed. tokenizer normalization switched, so same visible prefix hashes differently. continuous batcher rewarms many unique keys -> cache blowup.

alice: mitigation plan:
- turn off continuous batching for model-redwood-v2 in us-east-1
- throttle prefix cache writes, lower max_prefix_keys
- deploy temporary legacy-normalization shim for prefix hasher
- failover to model-redwood-v1 if needed

ops-mike: applying hotfix: disable continuous batching now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-change/disable-batching-1752501234 by ops-mike

ops-mike: command:
```
redwoodctl config set-serving --model model-redwood-v2 --region us-east-1 --continuous-batching false
```

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: config-change/disable-batching-1752501234 (3 nodes)

ben: after disable, queue depth dropping; 5xx rate halved in ~60s. cache shrinking from 118GB -> 42GB.

sara: CS update: @cust-success-raj — clients report better response times; a few in-flight errors remain.

cust-success-raj: Confirmed. acme-inc sees recovery. I'll schedule follow-up.

alice: next: throttle writes with feature flag limit 10/sec per prefix and aggressive eviction.

ben: applied feature.prefix_cache_throttle=10 for us-east-1/model-redwood-v2. write ops down ~70%.

ops-mike: evicted hottest keys:
```
redis-cli -h shard-us-east-1 --scan --pattern 'prefix:v2:0x9ab3f*' | xargs -L 100 redis-cli -h shard-us-east-1 DEL
```

sara: also prepare a shim to force legacy normalization while we fix templates.

ben: pushed patch to call normalize_legacy() before hashing. running canary.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/prefix-hash-legacy-1752501299 by ben

denial-bot: canary health check passed.

deploy-bot: canary succeeded: canary/prefix-hash-legacy-1752501299 (1 node)

ben: rolling to rest of region.
deploy-bot: rollout/prefix-hash-legacy-1752501320 started by ben

ops-mike: rollout finished. recommendation: keep continuous batching disabled for 5 more minutes, then re-enable cautiously.

alice: hold re-enable until one GC cycle completes. if stable, re-enable with smaller max_batch_size.

ben: metrics 30m post-mitigation:
- cache_size: 18.4GB
- 5xx rate: -82%
- median latency: baseline +10ms

sara: customer impact summary: acme-inc had ~16% error rate at peak; mitigated in ~22 minutes. follow-up call scheduled.

cust-success-raj: they accepted. severity downgraded P2 -> P3.

alice: postmortem TODOs:
- revert prompt template normalization change; reintroduce with tokenization unit tests (owner: docs-team)
- add unit tests for prefix hashing across unicode forms (owner: eng-ml)
- add safety throttle to batcher to detect rewarm storms (owner: eng-runtime)
- new dashboard alert for prefix_key_entropy threshold (owner: observability)

ben: filing incident doc with logs and exact commands. will include redis evict snippet and smoke tests.

sara: oncall handoff: @ben -> @alice in 30m. @alice will lead cleanup and postmortem.

alice: acknowledged. I'll close when docs and CS follow-ups are uploaded. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423-71 updated: status=mitigated | mitigations=disable-batching,throttle,legacy-prefix-hash | last_update=1752503432
